ICMR has detected two HMPV cases in Karnataka

A 3-month-old infant was diagnosed with HMPV and has been discharged, while an 8-month-old infant tested positive for HMPV after being admitted to the hospital. The infant is now recovering.

Both patients have no travel history. https://t.co/CuraZbJpuO
